description.en: Turns a six-step debugging chain (freeze facts, measure the real shape, minimal repro, single-variable comparison, judge, delivery gate) into a callable tool, with a boot self-check for path drift, missing files and version mismatch across package.json, index.js and CHANGELOG. Settings are per-item tunable with documented defaults, and every write keeps a backup for rollback.
description.zh: 把排障六步（冻结事实、量真形状、最小复现、单变量对照、判定器、交活闸）做成可调用的工具，并带零依赖开机自检：安装路径漂移、配方缺件、版本三处不一致。设置逐项可调且每项带说明，改动均留备份可退回。
